questions: The permutation of a compatible f is unique when every factor has two points (perm_unique); with one-point factors of equal dimension it is not (any such permutation represents the same automorphisms). So the homomorphism G → Perm(Fin p) (f ↦ σ_f⁻¹, compatiblePerm) with kernel G_I is stated under [∀ i, Nontrivial (B i)]; the printed index bound [G : G_I] ≤ p! is proved unconditionally (cosets of G_I inject into Perm). Reading, not finding: nothing printed depends on uniqueness.
σ_{f∘g} = σ_g σ_f with the printed convention m'ᵢ = φᵢ m_{σ(i)} (IsCompatibleAssocPi.mul: f with σ after g with τ is associated with τ * σ), hence f ↦ σ_f⁻¹ is the homomorphism.
